verdict.rationale: Workers' serverless isolate model inherently scales per-request with no capacity planning or server management (cloudflare-docs-1, cloudflare-docs-3), which implicitly delivers burst absorption, and community feedback confirms it's 'fast' and handles production load well (cloudflare-comm-3). However, there's no explicit autoscaling documentation, benchmark, or SLA evidence, and some community reports note CPU-time limits causing issues for sustained heavy workloads (cloudflare-comm-9), so full confidence in burst-absorption at scale isn't established.
